value: Duplicate products/delete delivery for the same product — the app checks current bundle status before writing; if already disabled, exit without additional Shopify calls.

Duplicate orders/paid delivery for the same order — the unique constraint on bundle_purchase_events(bundle_id, order_external_id) prevents double-counting; the purchase_count increment is guarded by the insert.

Merchant edits discount tiers on an enabled bundle — the app must update Shopify discount nodes atomically per tier; if any node update fails, the bundle is set to disabled and the merchant is notified via notify-merchant-bundle-disabled.

A bundle is auto-disabled because a member product is deleted — auto-disable-on-product-deletion deactivates all Shopify discount nodes and then invokes notify-merchant-bundle-disabled so the merchant can remediate.

A flexible-bundle customer selects a variant that sells out between widget load and cart submission — the Storefront cartLinesAdd returns a CartWarning for the out-of-stock line; the widget surfaces this and prompts the customer to reselect.

A bundle contains more than 100 component products — Shopify's productBundleCreate has component count limits; the app must validate member count against the platform limit before submission and reject the bundle creation with a clear admin error.

A merchant applies both a bundle discount and a manual discount code at checkout — the bundle's automatic discount is scoped to bundle product variants; the app should configure combinesWith: false on order discounts to prevent double-discounting on the same items.
